title: Twelve supplementary regulatory signpost questions: Pakistan and India
status: Registered by the first local Git commit containing this exact question file; see the external commit receipt. No forecast computed.
brief_relationship: Supplements, and does not replace, the final questionnaire's 18 country/pillar/year forecast cells.
start_rule: T0 is 00:00:00 local time on the first calendar day after the Git committer timestamp of the first local commit containing these questions, converted to the question country's timezone. Record that commit hash and both resulting T0 timestamps in an external run receipt before any projection. This removes same-day publication-time ambiguity.

common_resolution_rules.yes: YES requires a qualifying final official decision document, or an unambiguous officially published Approved entry with its reference, that establishes a new decision after T0 and by the deadline and its legal effectiveness by the deadline. The official publication must be dated by the event deadline. Later retrieval or an official archival copy is allowed until the resolution date. A later-republished old decision is not new.
common_resolution_rules.no: NO means no qualifying publicly documented decision was found after the prespecified official-channel searches and all required channels or their official archives were accessible. It is a finding about this public-documentation signpost, not proof that no confidential decision or product exists.
common_resolution_rules.unresolved: UNRESOLVED, with no forced binary outcome, if required official archives are inaccessible with no official substitute; dates, process, product identity, authorisation status or competent jurisdiction cannot be established; or surviving official records conflict without a controlling correction. Cap retrieval at three failed attempts per source, log the gap, and do not infer NO from a retrieval failure.
common_resolution_rules.publication_evidence: Capture the source PDF/HTML, document title, issuing authority, reference, document date, publication date, effective date, page/paragraph, URL, retrieval time and SHA-256. The source must itself establish the production platform; generic 'non-animal', 'vegan' or 'biotechnology' wording alone is insufficient.
common_resolution_rules.source_hierarchy: First use the signed decision or gazetted binding instrument; then the issuing regulator's official Approved register or official publication reproducing the complete decision. Official legal-code copies and official archives are fallbacks. A government press release is a locator unless it supplies an identifiable final decision and enough text to verify every criterion. Corporate/news/AI accounts cannot independently resolve YES.
common_resolution_rules.country_successors: A successor institution or relocated official URL may replace a named source only where an official legal/administrative document establishes succession. Record the mapping. Do not presume PSQCA standardisation, halal certification or a premises licence constitutes food-product approval.
common_resolution_rules.search_protocol: At resolution inspect the named authority's register/index and archive, then government gazettes/legal-code channels and official-domain site searches using the platform and product synonyms in English and Urdu where applicable. Check all four Pakistani provincial authorities for Pakistani questions. Log queries, dates and available date coverage; archive evidence. An absent public product register must not be described as exhaustive.
common_resolution_rules.scope: These are observable policy/regulatory signposts, not estimates of pillar sales, protein quantities, market shares, halal permissibility, actual availability, adoption or causal necessity for growth.
common_resolution_rules.revocation: The event is issuance and public documentation of a new decision that became legally effective by the deadline. Later withdrawal does not erase that historical event; record any withdrawal separately. A decision stayed or withdrawn before ever becoming effective does not qualify.
common_resolution_rules.horizon_dependence: The 2030/2035 pairs use the same start date and event definition at different deadlines. They are related horizon questions, not independent evidence or independent forecast draws.
common_resolution_rules.definition_boundary: Plant-based signposts concern meat/seafood alternatives only. Fermentation signposts concern precision-fermentation dairy/egg proteins only. These are deliberately named subsets of the questionnaire pillars. Cultivated signposts concern human food only; the instrument's pet-food exception remains in its separate replication track.
common_resolution_rules.no_estimation: No probability, market-size estimate, forecast quantile, survey denominator or diffusion fit is included.

questions.question: Between T0 and 2030-12-31, will FSSAI have publicly documented the following new decision, effective by that deadline: a new category-specific binding standard or labelling rule for plant-based meat or seafood alternatives?
questions.event_definition: FSSAI publishes, after T0, a new final regulation, amendment or legally binding direction that explicitly regulates plant-based meat or seafood alternatives and establishes or changes at least one category-specific requirement for permitted product naming, ingredient composition, or nutritional declaration. It must take legal effect by the event deadline.
questions.exclusions: Drafts, consultations, scientific-panel recommendations, voluntary guidance, generic vegan-logo rules, generic all-food labelling updates, and unchanged reprints do not qualify. A rule specific only to dairy alternatives does not qualify.
questions.interpretation: National regulatory-publication signpost; the direction of the rule may enable or restrict growth.

questions.question: Between T0 and 2030-12-31, will FSSAI have publicly documented the following new decision, effective by that deadline: a new precision-fermentation dairy or egg protein food authorisation?
questions.event_definition: FSSAI publishes, after T0, a new final approval for a named food or food ingredient containing a precision-fermentation-produced dairy or egg protein, for commercial human-food use in India, under the NSF approval process or a legally succeeding food-approval process. The approval must identify the product or ingredient, approval recipient, decision reference and effective approval date.
questions.exclusions: Pre-T0 approvals, renewals, ownership transfers, unchanged reissues, pending applications, research permissions, export-only permissions, conventional animal-derived dairy, fermentation enzymes or stabilisers that do not replace an animal-food sensory function, and excluded health supplements do not qualify.
questions.interpretation: Precision-fermentation dairy/egg subset of the fermentation pillar. Ingredient approval is a regulatory signpost only, not ingredient-market revenue or proof of finished-product sales.

questions.question: Between T0 and 2030-12-31, will FSSAI have publicly documented the following new decision, effective by that deadline: a new cultivated-meat product food-safety authorisation?
questions.event_definition: FSSAI publishes, after T0, a new final approval identifying a cultivated meat, poultry, seafood or organ-meat food product, including an explicitly identified cultivated-cell/plant hybrid, for commercial human-food use in India. The approval must identify the product, recipient, decision reference and effective approval date.
questions.exclusions: Pet food, feed, growth-media ingredients alone, research or pilot-cultivation permissions, tasting-only permissions, pre-T0 approvals, renewals, ownership transfers, unchanged reissues, pending applications and export-only permissions do not qualify.
questions.interpretation: Human-food regulatory signpost, separate from the questionnaire's cultivated-pet-food exception; approval does not prove retail sales.

questions.question: Between T0 and 2030-12-31, will PSQCA acting through a compulsory notification, or a provincial food authority acting within its jurisdiction have publicly documented the following new decision, effective by that deadline: a new category-specific binding standard or labelling rule for plant-based meat or seafood alternatives?
questions.event_definition: A competent Pakistani federal authority or the Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa or Balochistan food authority publishes, after T0, a new final legally binding instrument that explicitly regulates plant-based meat or seafood alternatives and establishes or changes at least one category-specific requirement for permitted product naming, ingredient composition, or nutritional declaration. It must take legal effect in at least one of those four provinces by the event deadline.
questions.exclusions: Drafts, consultations, panel recommendations, voluntary Pakistan Standards without an instrument making them binding, generic halal rules, generic all-food labelling updates, unchanged reprints and dairy-only analogue rules do not qualify.
questions.interpretation: At-least-one-province regulatory-publication signpost. Record each covered province; one province does not establish nationwide access.

known_baseline_trap.rule: Only qualifying decisions after T0 count; already-existing approvals do not qualify.

remaining_limitations: These questions define official-publication events because public exhaustive product-approval registers have not been established for every Pakistani authority.
